scope: Prospective follow-up using frozen programs after inspection of the original study. Not a preregistration of the original study.
question: Does scenario-specific selection improve accuracy on unseen inputs over selection by overall behavioral accuracy?
refined_operator_control: O_plus has exactly the same scores and tie distributions as P in every prepared context. Their expected utility is necessarily identical on any common evaluation set.

candidate_pools.rule: Five classical programs and the matching repetition of each of four LLM conditions.
candidate_pools.eligibility: Original eligible programs fitting both demonstrations. No outcome-based exclusions.

policy_scores.G: Original overall behavioral exact-output passed/evaluated over distinct inputs.
policy_scores.O: Weighted mean of original operator rates. Weights are the scenario calibration-input shares for each operator.
policy_scores.O_plus: As O, with S01 split by before/after insertion side.
policy_scores.P: The original complete profile-cell rate for the specified scenario.

ties.rule: G, O, O_plus and P first maximize their primary score, then the original overall behavioral score G. H uses only holdout information. Residual ties are uniform, evaluated analytically as their mean evaluation accuracy.
ties.control: Descriptive pure-score control uses a uniform choice among raw primary-score maximizers, without the secondary G score. No new execution observations needed.

calibration.equal_behavioral_information: G, O, O_plus and P use the same frozen behavioral observations. H is a lower-information reference, not a matched-cost baseline.

evaluation_inputs.rng_seed: SHA-256 of the namespace, interpreted as a nonnegative integer.
evaluation_inputs.template_sampling: Uniform over the fixed distinct calibration case templates for that task/scenario.
evaluation_inputs.source_input: The original demonstration referenced by the sampled template.
evaluation_inputs.V02: Uniformly choose a mutable unprotected ASCII alphanumeric run outside the target span. Replace it at the same length, using each character position's original letter-case/digit alphabet.
evaluation_inputs.V03: Uniformly choose a mutable run before the target. Set total prefix length uniformly between demonstrated maximum plus one and four times that maximum. Append fresh characters in the run's alphabet.
evaluation_inputs.V04: Uniformly choose a mutable run inside the target. Set target length uniformly between demonstrated maximum plus one and four times that maximum. Append fresh characters in the run's alphabet.
evaluation_inputs.V05: Replace an eligible atomic target with one fresh character from the original first character's alphabet. Retain only extrapolation cases in scenario L.
evaluation_inputs.S01: Reuse the fixed insertion side and supported delimiter/marked-block template. Insert one field/block. Sample its content length uniformly from 1 to four times the maximum demonstrated output length, and fresh characters from the alphabet used by the existing S01 rule.
constraints: Both reference implementations must agree on validity and the nonempty contiguous exact output.
Preserve protected delimiters and markers, except the explicit S01 insertion.
Enforce the scenario expectation and range classification.
Reject all original source examples, all original targeted inputs, and all previously saved random-test inputs for that task.
No duplicate input within one draw. Across draws/scenarios overlap is allowed and measured. Reuse execution observations, not independent-sample claims.
evaluation_inputs.pre_execution_gate: Generate all draws before any new candidate execution. If a task/scenario has fewer than 10 valid novel inputs in any draw, exclude that task/scenario for all methods before execution and document the reason. Keep draws with 10 to 20 inputs at their actual sizes. Omit a task only if no scenario remains, and report the resulting task set. Stop the experiment if no task retains any eligible scenario.
evaluation_inputs.failure_policy: An oracle disagreement halts generation. Do not resolve it using candidate outputs. No changes to operators, seeds, thresholds or selection rules after observing new results.

execution.runtime_source: Resolved runtime images and program/grammar hashes from each frozen evaluation provenance.
execution.controls: Replay both demonstrations and all original heldout and behavioral observations once per frozen program before new tests. A mismatch halts the affected execution and invalidates completion.
execution.program_failures: Exceptions, non-string outputs and program timeouts count as failed exact-output tests under the existing scoring rules.
execution.infrastructure_failures: Unresolved. Resume the exact frozen jobs after recovery. Do not turn infrastructure failures into program failures or remove methods.
execution.caching: Identical input/program/runtime combinations may share one observation. Retain all logical memberships.

budget_upper_bounds.wall_time: Not measured. Estimate from a fixed first five task IDs only after runtime setup. Do not use their outcomes to change the plan.

aggregation.per_candidate_draw: Fraction of exact outputs correct among the common accepted inputs.
aggregation.per_policy_draw: Average candidate accuracy over all maximizers frozen for that policy.
aggregation.within_task_scenario: Average over five candidate blocks and five evaluation draws.
aggregation.overall: First average equally over applicable scenarios within each task, then weight tasks equally.
aggregation.per_scenario: Report separately with its own task count.
aggregation.uncertainty: 20,000 paired task-cluster BCa bootstrap samples for primary P-G, with percentile sensitivity and number of nonzero task contributions. Keep all scenarios, blocks, draws and policies of a sampled task together. Intervals conditional on frozen programs, calibration and realized evaluation inputs.
aggregation.constant_difference: Report the constant observed difference and do not fabricate an informative bootstrap interval.
aggregation.secondary: P-H, P-O, scenario-specific differences, first-block control, draw stability, and leave-one-benchmark-source-out sensitivity are descriptive. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim for them.
aggregation.hindsight_reference: Report distance to the best of the nine candidates on the mean of all evaluation draws per task/scenario/block. Label as an optimistic finite-test reference, never used for selection.

interpretation_rules: Different selected candidate sets are not yet evidence of improved accuracy.
A positive P-G result supports scenario-specific selection over a single overall score within this study.
A positive P-O result supports finer grouping beyond the original unsplit operators, potentially localized to scenario I.
No result can establish P superiority over O_plus here, because their prepared selection policies are identical.
Do not claim the entire taxonomy, new task families, arbitrary deployment distributions or a general program-selection algorithm are validated.
Keep zero/negative results and all prespecified scenarios. No early stopping on a favorable outcome.
output_requirements: Generated cases with parent template, rejection reason counts, exact expectations and input hashes
Full raw execution observations and infrastructure status
Paired differences, intervals, controls and concise report
